notes.title: Update V2024.11.10_test:
notes.notes:
Hello our dear Desert Dwellers!
A little update for you on this wonderful Sunday!

As always, you can access this version by right clicking on TLD in Steam, select properties, then select betas, then select the upcoming version test.
! WARNING ! - This update now breaks old saves and saved cars!

V2024.11.10_test:

 Parts and Attachables are now using the same script!
     (This should make things easier and more stable in the future, as well as open up new possibilities!)
 But be aware this also now broke old saves, and saved cars!
 Fixed sometimes not being able to drive forward until releasing and pressing forward again.
     This was a long standing and very annoying thing, and is now gone.
 Cars no longer hitch when pausing the game. This was again a bug that was annoying players for a 
     while now, it is now also gone.
 Fixed Reflections not turning on-off based on distance
 Settings files and saved cars in the dev menu are now saved with JsonUtility
     (They should be more tolerant to changes, and are more readable)
 Fixed sometimes dropping stuff instead of equipping
 Added item spawn history in dev menu showing the last 40 items ( no, you can't clear it )
 Tape measure sticks to surfaces a little bit more reliably!
 Added toggle to dev menu to save using Json
     (It is now possible to load both Json and Binary which was used so far)
 Added buttons to dev menu to delete not generated POI and destroyed Ojb data
     (POI=Buildings, Obj=cacti, rocks...)
 Autosave is a lot less noticable!
 Stabilized some starting item spawn things
 Buried stuff spawns again
 Added ability to make an autosave with [ Home ] when dev mode is enabled
 Pumpkin on-off save fixed! (And new ones are randomly on-off)
 Snowballs and snowalls can be now made looking through the wheel also, now less "accidents" will 
     happen related to this feature.
 Bats are back! Yay!
 Fixed some very big, major save-load errors
 Dev menu car save-load works again!
 Fixed lights not being able to turn on-off after dismount
 Adjusted Van Physics Lock
 Fixed empty tanks and ammo resetting to being full on save-load
 Fixed coffin Physics Lock not working
 Fixed some attached stuff jumping to it's previous attached position when attached
 Fixed random type selector not using seed at POIs
     (Like the big grass a round the old house appearing/dissappearing on save-load )
 You can now select your starting car from the Dev Menu!
 Fixed dev menu car save-load attaches spawning mirrored!
 Fixed paint cans spawning empty
 There are now 3 autosave slots, these should come in handy for you guys, and should make life 
     easier.
 Save name increment when opening the save screen if it already exists,
     so it is now faster to save multiple times within the same minute,
     because it doesn't want to overwrite it!
 Fixed stuff spawned in boxes not staying in it
 Fixed teleporting far away if the held tape measure is stuck to a gib that dissappears
 Start items are saved on other maps! (func_pushables in bsp maps too)
 Fixed cacti destroy load
 Hopefully more varied building spawn!
 Buildings now again spawn further from the road too
 Fixed buildings not spawning in the first chunk
 Fixed bike03 tank not spawning in the starting house
 Water towers are now back too!
 Buried item spawn at water towers and such
 Some part lerp fix
 Fixed Mountains, cacti, rocks... random scale
 Some buildings now spawn along side roads, some only along main roads, and some only further 
     away from roads! (This should make things more interesting, especially in the future!)
 Fixed car door and window not affecting the outside sound volumes correctly
 Fixed multiplayer attach, local pos something
 Fixed multiplayer item pos something
 Better multiplayer client item positioning (Important, if you want to have fun in multiplayer!)
 Fixed height map maps not working
 Mouse Driving now only Steers by default, you can Toggle it to affect the pedals too by holding [ U ]
     (And yeah, don't forget that we have this feature - it can be really fun!)
 Fixed attached stuff to surfaces not being in the same place in multiplayer
 Some worn concrete material is now less shiny and is more bumpy!
 Fixed not having a Start House on Village map
 Light switch and such Save and Sync on FPS Dungeon map
 The FPS Dungeon Map now has corridors, rooms, has enemies, and has imaginary goals : Kill all the 
     enemies, find the computer and bring it back to the start room! You can have fun with this in 
     multiplayer also!
 We have a new shelf with Physics Lock system, it is in the starting room in the FPS Dungeon Map, 
     but you can also spawn it in the normal game mode using the Dev Menu (it will spawn naturally 
     later)!

Thank you for playing and testing, and as always, don't be shy!  Have fun....
'TILL YOU DIE!
Genesz, Gus, Gab, Doc

notes.title: Anniversary Beta Update
notes.notes:
Happy anniversary for everyone.

We have been fighting together in the desert for five years now. 
Who would have thought that when about six years ago the three brothers decided to make a game together that not many had thought of until then.
They wanted to make a game that works according to their own vision and will not be another game on the assembly line that will then be forgotten.
I don't think even they thought that they would reach so many players with this game.

However, we hope that the wait was at least a little worth it. 
It is not certain that all changes are obvious, but Genesz has had a very hard time to get to this point with the development. 

Since there are some major changes "under the hood", this update will be available in beta for now.
You will find it in the "beta - Upcoming version test" branch.
(Right click on TLD, properties, betas, beta - Upcoming version test)

Changelog:
V2024.09.25_test:

 Some changes since v2023.04.19c may be gone :(
 New terrain generator
  Multiplayer greatly improved
 Added Developer Mode in Settings in Misc tab
 Can change maps (Default, Test, FPS Dungeon...)
 Can load BSP maps (put them and wad files in Documents\TheLongDrive\Maps)
 Can load map from height maps from .png and .jpg formats
 (height map's name should end with _height)
 (color map's name should end with _color)
 (put height map and texture map in Documents\TheLongDrive\Maps)
 Using E+Mouse to tune no longer stops if the knob moves out of the crosshair
 Added lightbulb items
 Lights paintable
 Added big mirrors
 Better VR
 Can Toggle VR (In Misc Settings)
 Ignition/start and horn have now trigger,
 so you can look at them and press the use key to use them
 Changed stuff "under the hood"
 Some stuff gets sliced on destroy instead of just disappearing
 Fixed chocolate collider scale
 Changed Discord Server Link
 Changed headlight cookie
 New radio content
 New magazines
 New voices for Munkas


Known issues:


 In multiplayer: If someone is sitting next to you in the front right seat, you may not be able to start or stop the car's engine. The error does not exist if your companion moves to another seat or gets out. (This bug is being fixed)
 It is possible that the terrain is generated beyond the realistic limits. It is still heavily under development.
 There are currently no cellars or basements in any of the buildings.
 There are currently no cactus and electric poles.
 Dont save when you sit in a vehicle because it cause some error.
 After this update or later hotfixes, old saves and mods may become unusable in beta.


Please always make sure that you are running the latest possible version, because if this is not the case, it may cause problems in multiplayer.

There are still a lot of bugs that we know about and we will fix them, and of course we look forward to your comments. So prepare for fixes in the next days or weeks or maybe years... :D 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810834/067d58bb94abdd55df9303d1667247e819fe05c1.png

We will continue to work here, thank you for staying with us.

Genesz, Gus, Gab, Doc

notes.title: Hotfix/Patch 2023.04.17b.
notes.notes:
Hello our dear desert riders!

We are here again with some news, new stuff, and many interesting things!
CHANGES/FIXES/Things added since the last post:

 
 Added spirit water bubble level tool instrument thingy ( YES! )
  Added new Trophy! (And they should spawn now)
  Fixed being able to attach things to the thin air, if looking at buildings or the terrain
  Fixed the bus locking its own wheels again! :@
  Collider size of locked wheels now update with different wheels
  Fixed not being able to attach trailers to the big vehicle 
  Added "Reduced Debris" option the the misc tab in the settings
   (If enabled, breakable things fall into less pieces and those disappear too)
  Poles are now tilted, and most of the road side buildings are now connected to them.
    (This will gain importance in the future)
  Fixed some attachables getting frozen in air on loading!
  Changed baskets and such things attaching again, they should now attach with their closest point to the closest point on the sufrace that you are looking at, and not exactly to the point you are looking at.
(Hope you understand! Because we don't)
  Fixed not being able to attach trailers (broke with the previous fix)
  Fixed licence plate and other attachables not loading correctly when attached to the slots of the bike seats
  Attaching baskets and a few attachable things now should be easier, because they no longer use their center, but their closest point for attaching
  Bike's steering with keyboard is now slower on higher speeds, this should make the controls of the bikes a lot better!
   (And they should bounce slightly less)
  Fixed player preview not visible in player tab
  Fixed the bus locking its own wheels ( :@ )
  Adjusted trailer center of mass to make it a bit more stable (not the car transporter, but the small one!)
 Pallet is now attachable and has physics lock zone! (This is very interesting and unlocks amazing new upportunities!)
 Rail-part-chunk-something is now attachable
 Fixed some errors from the bug reports sections (Steam and Discord)
 Added some things to make older mods work!
 Removed VR from the main branch
   (It is now in the betas called vrtest, it also has multiplayer)
 Fixed bike's seats color not saving
  Fixed the new vehicle's tank pouring angle
  Fixed coffin, bed and rear seats now spawning



There will be a live stream about the new stuff on 04. 19. Follow up


  Thank you for your continued support, we are working as hard as we can, to make the game better for you guys!
  As always, have fun testing, and don't get sand in your pants!

Genesz:
Hey everyone!
As always this update is both delayed and rushed, it seems like that is the only way to do it.
So thank you for the patience!

After the previous update back in november the plan was to bring back the christmass and winter stuff from v20191227winter, fix a few things and start working fully on multiplayer again.
There wasn't enough progress made to be done before christmass, so this update was in the works instead.

Now after the unavoidable hotfixes will be out, the plan would be to work on multiplayer.
But that is not so simple. Syncing a few things is not that hard, but the game under the hood is like an overcomplicated rusty pipe system made of badly written moldy spaghetti code living in a dark basement with slimy angry looking spider creatures crawling on everything. And hissing at me.

In the past few years I have gained a lot of experience, now I should be able to do much better.
So a lot of the main scripts need to be rewritten, like the:

 terrain generation
 building generation
 save-load system
 item manager

If these don't work properly (and they don't) the multiplayer will not either.
And it is not efficient to implement new features to them, or other systems depending on them either.

Playing with older versions which have the previous terrain generation now almost make me sick.
They didn't made me sick back then, because they felt great then, but they weren't.
And the current one feels not too bad now, but I want to have a very good one, and be very sick of this one, when that comes out.

I don't like to talk about plans like this, because they never work, something always crosses them out, and the game should do the talking anyway by it's improvements, and not me. If I'm talking, then I'm not working.
But it is good to see the community on the discord server already sharing their experience with this update and the activity on other places.
I would interact more with you, but "sadly" there are so many of you and I'm a man of a few words, aren't I?
You know that if you saw the previous live streams. Speaking of those, there should be one sometime about this update on the TLD youtube channel, I'm sure it will be posted on the TLD facebook page, if you are afraid you miss it. 

Have fun with this update!
Hopefully the next one won't take much longer as the average updates took this far.

I've made some progress with the multiplayer too, it is not much, so it's not uploaded yet, but I think there will be a new version relatively soon.
I still don't know how exactly will I make it as good as it should be, but it seems like it will be at least playable, and we will see from there.
I still need to learn and practice making multiplayer, but it seems doable.

The progress I've made is:
The color and condition of the car and the parts is now synced and I've wrote the code for syncing the mounting and dismounting, but... it didn't do anything yet and I have no idea why, but that is an usual problem, I think it is not because of the networking part, but just the programming of it, so shouldn't be that hard to find it. 
When I'll fix that, it will be a huge leap, because then the car will not fall apart every second and you will be able to travel together...

Well at least for a while, until you reach 2.5 km, then comes the next problem which I'll have to fix (I thought I did already, but it will be a lot easier to test it once the car doesn't fall apart).
To put it simply, the further you go from the middle of the coordinate system, the less resolution the space has. For example near the origin, the smallest ammount you can move is less than a millimeter, so everything is moving smoothly, or stays where it should be, but if you are far away, the smallest you can move can be more than a centimeter (or meter if you go far enough), so everything is vibrating between two positions and jumping around.
This is fixed in singleplayer by just teleporting back everything if the player is above a certain distance (2.5 km) from the origin and keeping track of the distances teleported back in "higher resolution" variables.
And I think you can imagine how this can cause problems in multiplayer (and with literally everything in the game).
And there is an other problem that for example when breaking a beer bottle, for the other player a wheel spawns instead of bottle shards. And first it seems like it is easy, because it may send the wrong item id and that's it. But it isn't always a wheel, it can be a coolant or bus trap door, anything, it seems random. I think the reason for this is because the save system gives the id's to the items (the id which differentiates between all items, like bottle1, bottle2 not the type id which tells if it's a wheel or a bottle) one after the other, so first item to spawn is 1, second 2... and so on. And what if one of the players breaks a bottle and sends the two shards spawned to the others? It sends that there is a shard with an id of 14 and an other with 15. The other player gets it and if it has no items with such id's then it is all good, it spawns the two shards where they should be, but if that player already has an item with  id 14, it thinks that the item should move there instead. Whatever it is, it will move there. This may be the cause that I saw a bus jumping around in the desert instead of a rabbit.
The obvious solution that everything should be spawned and calculated and handled on the server wouldn't work because of the previous problem, what if the server's character is far away? Item's wouldn't spawn where they should be, physics rely on the coordinates too.

This may seem like a complaint or something, but I just wrote down what's up, so you know what I'm working on currently and because most of you are interested in multiplayer more than in VR or any other thing (obviously, I can't wait it either). But if you are interested in more content and features, don't worry, I can't wait to make them either.

Thank you for reading and your patinece! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: News about the upcoming update
notes.notes:
The new terrain generation is finally using the unity job system, so far it looks like it will worth it.

There is no cacti and small rocks yet, but hopefully those will not add that much stress to the CPU.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810834/b40f2d142d982dc8ea5d354e679086165d369316.gif

It can easily keep up with high speeds.
The distant terrain's draw distance is 100km (in the current version (v20191103) 30km is the max). 
The previous gif can make the mountains and the map look small, but:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810834/e8be0682ab7856401e899ac94924c7e2ee069234.gif

The map is now about as big as Earth (40 075 km at the equator, that is now the map's side length, and you can go "around")
So far the mountains were spawned by the cacti spawn system, and that caused a few problems especially with a lower draw distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810834/22a1cf1914aafa7a95705fdb321db5af71d29ec3.gif

But now the mountains spawn in about a 10km radius, they have a new system, and they will not depend on the cacti or the high resolution terrain (which only spawns as far as you set the draw distance).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810834/57ff1ce4d35e36fb0b791115b82db6d4ef526ec7.gif

So it seems like the unity job system will get the job done, as the CPU usage is lower and things will be more stable. Those who have crashes with v20191103 will most likely not have anymore after this update comes out.
(if they were caused by multi threading issues)

You can access the TEST version through steam betas (Upcoming version test) but it doesn't have main menu, you can't save or load, there is no road, no items, settings may not work, but there is a car with a full tank and a big desert.

(and this new generation supports multiple "important objects" around which the terrain generates, not just the player ;) )

There is still a lot of work to do, but hopefully we can release the update before Christmas.

Thank you for your patience! :D

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ICuW-nQeWmc

notes.title: Update V20191004
notes.notes:
Added syphon hose
 Added Steering Wheel and Controller Support
 Added option for automatic clutch and shifting.
 Mounting parts is now significantly easier (you don't have to look at the hinges anymore)
 Refilling the car is more beginner friendly (you don't have to look exactly at the tank cap)
 When you open a door, now you have to move the mouse in the direction you want the door to move, not just up and down, so it makes sense now
 When dismounting tires from rims, they shouldn't fly away now
 Slightly better performance and now the draw distance slider should work correctly so there will be no more crashes (because of the slider) and if you decrease it, the performance boost will be noticeable
 Odometer's last digit, which shows 100 meters is now yellow
 From now on you can't open the caps slightly with scrolling, because it not really had any use, and was in the way for smooth crouching or bringing objects closer.
 smaller changes in map generation


Saves from last version should be able to load correctly :D

We had too many things planned and we ran out of time, so this week's big update got sliced into two parts, this is the first one, the second one will hopefully come next week.
Thank you all for playing!

If you want to report bugs, give suggestions any feedback, or you just want to talk about the game, you are welcome on our discord server.
Have fun!
